title: Compose and verify the XSD datatype value library

acceptance.description: Implement XSD 1.0 lexical/value spaces, numeric/date/duration/binary/QName families, equality and comparison.
Test whitespace/lexical/value boundaries, timezone comparisons, namespace context and invalid data.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.

Compose all verified core/numeric/temporal/text-binary children into the complete frozen IXmlDatatypeLibrary, registry lookup/whitespace/type queries and list/union/retyping behavior. Run cross-family and built-in completeness checks, preserve all original acceptance and include RNG datatype-namespace mapping. No advertised datatype may remain a placeholder or exclusion. Implement and test built-in NMTOKENS, IDREFS and ENTITIES parsing, XML whitespace tokenization, required nonempty forms, atomic lexical failures, exact quotas/cancellation and owned immutable item lists using the verified atomic providers.

handoff.summary: Unclaimed work split into four focused children; this task owns final complete library composition and verification. Original A1-A3 remain unchanged.
